newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo declines comment on takeover report.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo declines comment on takeover report.

text.p: Officials at Hanbo Steel Corp said on Thursday they had no comment on newspaper reports that its main creditor banks wanted it to be taken over by a third party.
The report said Hanbo had asked the banks to extend 300 billion won in loans to finance its investment in a new steel plant in South Korea's southwestern city of Tangjin.
The company, one of the nation's leading producers of steel products, has been suffering from a heavy financial debt burden, the report said.
Hanbo, which had a paid-in capital of 88.41 billion won as of the end of 1995, posted a net loss of 17.2 billion won in 1995 on a turnover of 432.9 billion won.
